senses.gloss:
bodhi (LL), Buddhist; supreme knowledge^1 attained by the Buddha; the tree of enlightenment; cf. mahābodhi, saṃbodhi.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210207. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/51.
bodhi-cakra (LL), Buddhist; the wheel of enlightenment.
Bodhisattva (CII 2-1; LL), Buddhist; a would-be Buddha in a previous birth. Cf. Chadmastha.
bodhyaṅga, cf. bojjhaṅga (EI 5), Buddhist; seven in number.
